Route each shot to the right model (Veo, Kling, Seedance 2.0) per shot, not per platform

stats.fact: Higgsfield's The Cully Hill Boys is a 110-minute AI feature film produced for ~$2 million in 4 weeks by a 28-person team
About half of the $2M budget went to compute; a comparable traditional production costs $20-100M and takes 12-18 months
The film used ~600 approved assets: 74 cards for leads/villains, 52 supporting, 90 background, 159 props, 200+ location base maps
The team produced nearly 1,000 assets and 100 AI-generated locations; 40% of the 28-person team had no prior AI experience
Multi-agent video productions typically run 6-8 specialist agents in parallel with teams of 1-4 people over 2-5 days
Cost-per-finished-minute for multi-agent AI video production lands between $315 and $750
A 2-minute brand film ran 8 specialist agents across separate project pages in 3 days for ~$1,500 vs a traditional equivalent of $100K-$500K
Higgsfield's pexo-style open-source skills: a 15-second 3-shot product ad renders in under 8 minutes; a 60-second brand video takes ~20 minutes
Higgsfield's Cinema Studio platform helped a South Korean ad company decrease production costs by 97%
stats.source: Thinkly / CEO Alex Mashrabov on LinkedIn

angles: The $2M AI feature film as proof that agent skills + orchestration compress a Hollywood pipeline 50x

Open-sourcing the pipeline as a marketing play and a blueprint for indie creators
